prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I did that quick hop from Beijing down to Shanghai, and I remember thinking the whole rail setup between those two cities was way smoother than I expected.
Later that same year I was in Chongqing for a weekend, and everyone kept arguing about which theaters there were actually worth it.
For that Beijing–Shanghai run, my coworker had already gotten me on train G1, and it was all under the name Mike Davis.
I dug up the old email later—date was 2025-04-02, and it was just Second Class, nothing fancy.
And in Chongqing, my friend Song Qi had already bought two tickets for Kung Fu Panda 4 at CGV Raffles City—the showtime was 11:30, which felt ridiculously early for a movie.
